Print settings (important)

For pixel-accurate output, in the browser print dialog set:

  • Paper: A4
  • Margins: None
  • Scale: 100% (Default)
  • Background graphics: ON
  • Destination: Save to PDF is recommended. Avoid Microsoft Print to PDF for large batches.
Which feed fields are used + user logic

Feed fields used: SKU, brand, title, model/MPN, price, sale price, image link, product link, category, stock availability, extended warranty / EW status.

  • Normal mode: hides B- SKU bargain items by default.
  • Bargain items only ON: shows only SKUs starting with B-.
  • B- items: show Best Price, Last Unit, As is Condition, and warranty note.
  • B- warranty logic: above 50% discount = 3 Months Warranty; 50% or below = 6 Months Warranty.
  • EW display rule: No = display NA instead of EW price.
  • print page range: controls which A4 pages are generated for the current PDF print.
  • Page range logic: 4-up and strip layouts have 4 products per A4 page, 2-up has 2 products per A4 page, and 1-up has 1 product per A4 page.
